evals.prompt: スキルを作って。GitのPRを自動でレビューして、コメントの品質とかを見てくれるやつ
evals.expected_output: The skill asks clarifying questions (using AskUserQuestion) about what 'review' means — commit message quality, code changes, both? — before proceeding. It checks existing skills for overlap, proposes a single-responsibility design, confirms with the user, and hands off a complete spec to skill-creator.
assertions: Uses AskUserQuestion to clarify the scope of 'review' before designing
Checks whether an existing skill already covers this use case
Proposes a verb-based skill name like 'review-pr' or 'analyze-pr'
Produces a complete specification to hand off to skill-creator
Responds in Japanese throughout the conversation

evals.prompt: I want to add a slash command that converts CSV files to JSON format
evals.expected_output: The skill gathers requirements (what columns, what JSON structure, any transformations?), checks for existing skills that might handle this, designs a single-purpose skill called something like 'convert-csv', confirms with the user, and delegates to skill-creator with a clear spec.
assertions: Checks existing skills before proposing a new one
Asks at least one clarifying question about the expected JSON format or transformation rules
Hands off a complete English-language specification to skill-creator

evals.prompt: 新しいスキルを作りたいんだけど、データ分析してレポート作って、それをSlackに送って、あとダッシュボードも更新してくれるやつ
evals.expected_output: The skill recognizes this is too broad for a single skill, proposes splitting into multiple focused skills (e.g., analyze-data, generate-report, notify-slack, update-dashboard), and uses AskUserQuestion to confirm the split before proceeding.
assertions: Identifies that the request spans multiple distinct responsibilities
Proposes splitting into 2 or more separate skills
Uses AskUserQuestion to confirm the split with the user before proceeding
Does NOT attempt to design a single monolithic skill covering all four capabilities
